name: dftracer_build
description: Detect the build system, configure and build the original app (cmake, autotools, meson, pip), copy and patch the annotated tree to link dftracer, build it, report annotation coverage; validator dftracer_build_check (original: app_built + install tree; annotated: binary names libdftracer_core). Load on 'Unknown build tool', 'fatal error: dftracer/dftracer.h: No such file or directory', 'undefined reference to dftracer_init' / 'initialize_main', 'libdftracer_core.so: cannot open shared object file', '.deps/...Po:1: *** missing separator', an ignored -D flag, or an annotated build failing on a dftracer macro.

history.why: converted from dftracer-agents session_detect/configure/build_install/copy_annotated/patch_build/build_annotated/annotation_report (register_session_tools), skills dftracer-build-app and dftracer-build-run and the build entries of dftracer-pitfalls, agents dftracer-build-app and dftracer-build-system-{cmake,autotools,meson,pip}
